description_en: Converts provided text content into a high-quality speech audio file
description_zh: 本接口用于将提供的文本内容转换成高质量的语音音频文件
kebab_example: aliyun ice submit-audio-produce-job --editing-config voice_:_Siqi_,_format_:_MP3_,_volume_:50 --output-config 'For_example,_to_store_the_output_audio_at_http://my_bucket.oss-cn-shanghai.aliyuncs.com/target_audio.mp3,_configure_this_parameter_as:_     _bucket_:_my_bucket_,_     _object_:_target_audio' --input-config Audio_production_task --region cn-hangzhou
name: SubmitAudioProduceJob

parameters.help_en:
The audio production configuration:
voice: the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/449563.html.
customizedVoice: the VoiceId for voice cloning.
format: the output file format. Valid values: PCM, WAV, and MP3.
volume: the volume. Valid values: 0 to 100. Default value: 50.
speech_rate: the speech rate. Valid values: -500 to 500. Default value: 0.
    - [-500, 0, 500] corresponds to the speed multiplier range of [0.5, 1.0, 2.0].
    - The calculation method is as follows:
        - 0.8x speed: (1-1/0.8)/0.002 = -125
        - 1.2x speed: (1-1/1.2)/0.001 = 166
        - For speeds less than 1x, use the 0.002 coefficient.
        - For speeds greater than 1x, use the 0.001 coefficient.
pitch_rate: the pitch. Valid values: -500 to 500. Default value: 0.
<notice>If both voice and customizedVoice are specified, customizedVoice takes precedence.></notice>
parameters.help_zh:
音频生产配置：
voice https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/449563.html
customizedVoice 人声克隆的 VoiceId
format 输出文件格式，支持：PCM/WAV/MP3
volume 音量，取值0~100，默认值50
speech_rate 语速，取值范围：-500～500，默认值：0
    - [-500, 0, 500] 对应的语速倍速区间为 [0.5, 1.0, 2.0]
    - 计算方法如下：
        - 0.8倍速（1-1/0.8）/0.002 = -125
        - 1.2倍速（1-1/1.2）/0.001 = 166
        - 小于1倍速时，使用0.002系数
        - 大于1倍速时，使用0.001系数
pitch_rate 语调，取值范围：-500～500，默认值：0
<notice>如果同时传入voice和customizedVoice会优先使用customizedVoice。></notice>
